ui.tz_milestone_guide: Aag-waqtiga & beddelka (UTC{tz_str}): Siridarku waxay hagaajinaysaa bandhigga; beddelka UTC wuxuu u guuri karaa ganacsadaha maalintii hore ama xigtay.
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Mashiinka Waqtiga: Horay ama gadaal u mari maalmaha si aad u eegto xogta, u barbar dhig taariikhda. Kaliya waa daawasho.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 Saldhigga VN: waxay door bidaysaa xogta dhabta ah, waxay hubisaa socodka wajiga & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + leexashada guud ahaan k, p; daldaloolada 16 / 116 / 132 ama wareegga 1072 waxay isticmaashaa k*116 + p*16 guud ahaan k, p si ay u waafajiso wajiga, buuxinta daldaloolada horay haddii ay maqan yihiin.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Waxay caadi ahaan u noqotaa laxanka 119 (k*119 + leexashada); marka daldaloolku yahay 16 / 116 / 132 ama uu gaaro wareegga 1072 (qaabka 14-tallaabo), waxay isticmaashaa k*116 + p*16 guud ahaan k, p si loogu wareejiyo Wajiga A ee ku habboon (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: Waxay ku duubataa laxanka 119 (k*119 + leexashada); daldaloolada 16 / 116 / 132 ama wareegga 1072 (k*116 + p*16 guud ahaan k, p), waxay door bidaysaa wajiga la hagaajiyay ee A2 / C7 waana ay dib u gurataa marka xogtu maqan tahay.
